artifacts.corpus.pre.json: stage 3+prepare — the frozen corpus of record; immutable for the run
artifacts.converge-view.json: prepare — the projection convergence reads; pure function of corpus.pre.json
artifacts.converge-tables.json: prepare — corpus-level tables no single checker could compute
artifacts.converge.json: stage 4 — the agent's addressed, reasoned modification list
artifacts.corpus.post.json: stage 5 — written ONLY by the applier
artifacts.converge-effect.json: stage 5 — the derived record: diff, attribution, labels, convergence_status
artifacts.converge-attempts.json: stage 5 — the durable attempt counter the loop is enforced with

merge.scope: changed_fields on target.id; `after` is the WHOLE merged element

add.scope: creation of one MEMORY suggestion under target.tool_id

trim.scope: target.field on target.id; after must be a token-subsequence shortening

flag.scope: EMPTY — writes nothing to the corpus

demotion: any strict decrease in priority rank (P0 > P1 > P2 > P3 > not G-SEC): attributed over prominence_capable_ops, every attributed edit's reason.body names a prominence_consequence_token (else E-GATE-UNREASONED, gate kind demotion), disclosed expanded on the Overview; still failing at attempt 5 → forced conservative with a forced_display snapshot of the pre priority
corpus_versions: corpus.pre's contract_version and converge_version must be exactly this code's (type int, equal) — else CorpusVersionError: apply_converge raises at every attempt, --check/--submit exit 4 recording no attempt, build_view/build_tables refuse, assembly renders artefacts_inconsistent

C2-tags-visibility.attests: scanned.items exact; clean + distinct edited items cover every item

C3-security-only.attests: security_only_tools enumerates EVERY security_only tool with its cve_count and a verdict

C5-auto-approval.attests: tools enumerates EVERY security_auto or pre-accept-eligible tool with deciding_input + verdict

C6-memory.attests: the ledger: every proposal in exactly one disposition; every tagged proposal reviewed in both directions; fired_this_run recomputed

C7-collisions.attests: clusters_inspected == len(file_collisions); every surviving suggestion id resolves

E-SUBMIT-SHAPE.meaning: converge.json is not the contract's shape (object, edits[], checks[], ledger, corpus_effect)

E-SUBMIT-RUN.meaning: run_id does not match the session

E-SUBMIT-VERSION.meaning: converge_version or view_version does not match this contract

E-SUBMIT-DIGEST.meaning: corpus_digest does not match the corpus about to be applied to

E-EDIT-TARGET.meaning: target.id does not resolve, or target.field is illegal for target.kind

E-EDIT-PRECOND.meaning: precondition.before != the current value of target.field

E-EDIT-QUOTE.meaning: quote absent on a cut, or not verbatim-contained in the addressed element

E-EDIT-OP.meaning: op/kind/field combination illegal; bucket_claim on a non-bucket-capable op or absent on a bucket-capable one; changed_fields absent on a merge; trim's after not a shortening; a malformed reason

E-EDIT-DEP.meaning: requires names an unknown or rejected edit — transitively closed

E-EDIT-DUP.meaning: two edits write the same (element, field) with no supersedes chain between them

E-EDIT-ID.meaning: an add whose derived id collides with an existing id in that tool

E-APPLY-SCOPE.meaning: the derived change set != the declared scope set

E-APPLY-SCHEMA.meaning: corpus_post fails validation where corpus_pre did not — a merge/add payload that is not a valid element

E-APPLY-INTERNAL.meaning: the applier's own re-derivation disagrees with the validator's recorded axes on corpus_pre — an applier bug, never the agent's

E-CHECK-CLOSURE.meaning: a check attestation is missing/duplicated, or checks[].edits != the set of edits naming that check

E-CHECK-ARITH.meaning: an attestation count != the recomputed count

E-CHECK-OP.meaning: an edit's op is outside its check's output vocabulary

E-GATE-UNATTRIBUTED.meaning: a permissive move with no attributable cause — the §3 defect exactly

E-GATE-UNDECLARED.meaning: an attributed edit's bucket_claim.moves_bucket is false

E-GATE-UNREASONED.meaning: an attributed edit's reason.body does not name the consequence

E-EFFECT-ARITH.meaning: a corpus_effect number != recomputed — critical on tools_moved/pre_accept, a note otherwise

E-EFFECT-NARRATIVE.meaning: corpus_effect.narrative missing, or it fails the -20% enumeration rule

W-EDIT-CLAIM.meaning: a bucket_claim disagrees with the computed truth in a non-gated direction

W-STORE-UNCHECKED.meaning: a memory store was never snapshotted into the session — C6's store-dependent checks ran against nothing, which is not the same as against an empty store

W-SUBMIT-ATTEMPT.meaning: the declared attempt number disagrees with the durable counter; the counter governs

W-EDIT-SCHEMA.meaning: a touched element carries a new warning-severity finding

forced_bucket_rule: the most restrictive of the tool's pre bucket, the bucket it would have shipped, and — for a security-bearing tool (security bucket, has_security or a G-SEC priority on either side) — forced_bucket; forcing never loosens a tool and never files a non-security tool as security

label.present_iff: the tool's FINAL state is security_auto or initial_pre_accept is true, and the tool was not degraded-forced — absent otherwise, never null-filled
label.never_ships: judgement_unattributed — under the gate and loop as specified a permissive move with no attributable cause is rejected up to five times and then forced conservative, which removes the label key entirely
